title: A15 sandbox-artefact audit: code and derived data for 'Deep learning attribution of malware families from sandbox behaviour traces transfers poorly between installations of the same sandbox'
description: Code, derived data and documentation of a pre-registered audit of deep-learning malware family attribution across two installations of the CAPEv2 sandbox (MELD-DS-448 and WinMET): acquisition and sealing in a hash-chained ledger with RFC 3161 time-stamps, a frozen lexicon of behaviour, footprint and probing tokens, the evaluation engine, the measured results, figure code and the manuscript build. Derived data are under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; the token-level lexicon is available on request under a data-use agreement.
